item.title: Lawsuit challenges intimidation of DHS observers across the country
item.description: The sweeping lawsuit brought by Common Cause argues federal agencies are illegally surveilling and intimidating people who try to peacefully observe federal immigration enforcement activity.

item.title: After court flurry, Missouri officials set aside GOP redistricting
item.description: After a flurry of court maneuvers, the Republican redistricting of U.S. House seats in Missouri is blocked. It's a win for Democrats fighting to win control of the House — but maybe not over yet.
item.content:encoded: After a flurry of court maneuvers, the Republican redistricting of U.S. House seats in Missouri is blocked. It's a win for Democrats fighting to win control of the House — but maybe not over yet.

item.title: Anti-Muslim rhetoric is finding a growing foothold in GOP messaging ahead of November
item.description: A strain of anti-Muslim bigotry has become increasingly common in GOP politics, manifesting everywhere from a "Sharia-free America" caucus in Congress to rhetoric on the campaign trail.
item.content:encoded: A strain of anti-Muslim bigotry has become increasingly common in GOP politics, manifesting everywhere from a "Sharia-free America" caucus in Congress to rhetoric on the campaign trail.

item.title: In divided times, Gov. Cox prescribes passionate disagreement, minus contempt
item.description: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer talks with Spencer Cox, Republican governor of Utah, about his new book, Off Ramp, and his vision for peacemaking.

item.title: Elon Musk threatens to sue over Gibney documentary's "space lasers" claim
item.description: The tech billionaire's attorney has put documentarian Alex Gibney and his production company on legal notice, claiming the Oscar-winning director defamed Musk in his nearly four-hour documentary.

item.title: Trump gives primetime speech at GOP convention, promising payout if Republicans win
item.description: President Trump kicked off the Republican midterm convention with a primetime speech, outlining the Republican message and promising Americans a payout if the GOP wins the upcoming election.

item.title: One year after Charlie Kirk's death, Turning Point USA faces an uncertain future
item.description: The death of Charlie Kirk was seen as a rallying call for young conservatives. But as his supporters reflect on the past year, some paint a more complicated picture of the organization he left behind.

item.title: Vance, Trump issue plea for Americans to vote Republican on last night of convention
item.description: President Trump again touted his "Trump dividend" in his closing speech at the Republican convention. Vice President Vance used his remarks to urge voters to back Republicans, even if they disagree.
